summary: Scaling by p^{j_p} divides the gauge by p^{j_p} ≥ p^{m·2fa/p} ≥ p^{m·collisionSum}.

steps.claim: For every point g: B_μ(ϑ, Ψ)(p^{j_p}v) = p^{j_p}·B_μ(ϑ, Ψ)(v), whose gauge is p^{−j_p} times; by `gaugeLe_collisionSum`, collisionSum(p, ∅) ≤ 2fa/p (`collisionSum_le` with o = 1) and j_p ≥ m·2fa/p, so the gauge is ≤ p^{loss − gain}.
steps.lean:
GaugeLe 1 (p ^ (D.loss p - D.gain p)) (Bμ ϑ Ψ ((p : ℂ) ^ D.jetCeil p • v)) := fun g ↦ by
  erw [map_smul, weylGauge_smul]; grw [jetCeil, H.gaugeLe_collisionSum hQ hv h g,
    collisionSum_le (·.1.1), Nat.le_ceil (D.m * _ : ℝ)]
    <;> simp [norm_p_eq_inv, add_sub_assoc, rpow_add, hp.1.pos, hp.1.one_le, NeZero.ne]
